analysis: Only docs/architecture/inference.md changed, and no code or controls were supplied. I reviewed the two base-text units (lines 1-831). The patch excerpt is truncated and shows one visible head change at line 61, the EngineV2SlotFactory table row. It adds that a refused SSD store's typed reason reaches the bridge 'for local /metrics only'. That touches T-041 (SSD prefix cache, SEC-035 accepted TTFT oracle). It is a documentation claim that code in EngineV2SlotFactory*.swift and EngineV2Bridge would have to enforce. Whether the reason string stays out of coordinator heartbeats, capacity quotes, consumer-visible responses or logs cannot be checked here. Head-side changed ranges (71-310, 911-919, 937, 948-968, 1239-1264, 1512-1519) were not supplied. The base-side ranges (61, 671, 689, 700-701) correspond to the removed row and reasoning-prefix text, which I did not confirm against any head text. Nothing in the supplied evidence widens the prefix-cache at-rest surface, changes TTL, HMAC naming or cacheSalt scoping, or adds new surface. Integration should check two things: whether the typed refusal reason is exposed only on the local /metrics endpoint and not in coordinator-visible capacity data; and whether the added head text still states the T-041 SSD tier accurately (30-minute TTL, KEK-derived HMAC names, per-donation gate). No security conclusion is possible about the unseen head content.
